source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Configuration" -> Click "SNMP"
Check SNMP information when it is enabled.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: SNMP v1/v3 function should be normal and information should be displayed correctly.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: net-snmp + a 2nd host; BMC SNMP agent configured by operator
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP v1/v3 verifies the BMC SNMP agent/trap functionality; it needs a management/trap-receiver host and enabling/configuring SNMP on the BMC Web UI (community/v3 + trap destination). Agent can from the trap receiver run `snmpget -v3 ... "$BMC_IP" system.sysDescr.0 2>&1` to sanity-check the agent after it is configured by the operator.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpget/walk output confirming the BMC SNMP agent responds for the SNMP v1/v3 mode; the trap destination/receiver setup + Web UI enable is the operator part.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: enabling SNMP + pointing traps is a config change on the BMC; needs a 2nd host as trap receiver and read-only community.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; correctly recognizes attended BMC configuration plus automatable queries, but its abbreviated v3 command is not executable and cannot cover v1 or unspecified trap behavior.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; usefully identifies missing mode/security/OID scope, but overstates ordinary Project Test Plan inputs as an irreducible blocker for this clearly named protocol-function test.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 749/2291 remains PARTIAL and package/operator gated, matching the hybrid execution boundary but lacking per-mode evidence design.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Its REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION result is non-counting history; the classification was independently re-evaluated under ED-36.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-36 treats mode matrices, credentials and expected values as execution-readiness inputs when purpose is identifiable; ED-38 keeps final verdict ownership separate.

original_test_intent: Validate the BMC's approved SNMPv1 and SNMPv3 management behavior and configuration display as separate protocol/security checkpoints, with any trap coverage explicitly defined rather than inferred.
original_method: An engineer enables or inspects SNMP in BMC WebUI. The sparse source does not define exact OIDs, expected values or whether the slash means both modes, but those can be supplied by a Project Test Plan without changing the named core purpose.
manual_activity: An engineer must approve and operate the BMC WebUI configuration/display checkpoint. The agent can then execute separately defined read-only v1 and v3 transactions and compare returned values, making the case hybrid rather than wholly manual.
required_inputs: whether both v1 and v3 are required or a security-approved subset
per-mode community or SNMPv3 user/security-level/auth/privacy profile
isolated manager identity, UDP ACL and synchronized time
vendor MIB and approved OID/value matrix
redacted configuration backup, restore and retention policy
safety_requirements: Do not enable or reconfigure SNMP until the management network, modes, manager and security profile are approved.
Never expose community strings or SNMPv3 authentication/privacy keys in commands, screenshots, logs or Review Records.
Use least-privilege read-only views and restrict traffic to the approved manager/ACL.
Do not infer v1 results from v3, or query behavior from trap settings; record each required checkpoint independently.
Restore or explicitly retain the configuration per approval and do not automatically retry authentication or configuration failures.
agent_execution_scope: After engineer setup, run complete version-appropriate read-only queries for each approved OID and capture redacted responses, errors, latency and manager/BMC identity.
Compare values to the Project SPEC and correlate with engineer-provided WebUI artifacts.
Do not change BMC configuration, handle plaintext secrets, generate unspecified trap stimuli or assign final verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the required mode/function matrix, security profiles, OIDs and Expected Values.
Operate and document WebUI configuration/display, approve cleanup and any trap sub-scope.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The abbreviated `snmpget -v3 ...` is not executable as written, proves neither v1 nor both-mode functionality and improperly blends agent query with trap receiver scope; its hybrid boundary is nevertheless directionally correct.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use separate owner-approved Net-SNMP v1 and v3 read-only commands with exact OIDs, expected values and protected credential injection; add a trap receiver only if trap coverage is explicitly in the project plan.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The WebUI procedure, v1/v3 wording, normal/correct information Criteria and 5/0-minute values remain preserved source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Split v1 and v3 into explicit checkpoints, record WebUI mode state, issue least-privilege read-only queries for approved MIB objects, compare exact values and negative access behavior, then restore the configuration.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: BMC firmware and Project security policy that explicitly state supported/allowed SNMP modes.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, vendor MIB, Net-SNMP and security algorithm versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor BMC SNMP/MIB and Project management-network/security specifications.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds observable per-mode protocol evidence and secret handling while retaining the attended WebUI checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful v3 GET cannot claim v1, all MIB information or trap delivery; each remains separately reported.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SNMPv1 may be prohibited; a valid project override must record the unverified source coverage.

project_override_considerations: A Project SPEC may prohibit SNMPv1 and validate only approved SNMPv3 profiles, but it must record v1 as unverified source coverage. It may add trap checks separately and must not claim them from ordinary GET/WALK responses.
expected_evidence: redacted WebUI configuration/display artifact and pre/post state
approved v1/v3 mode and security matrix plus manager/ACL/tool metadata
per-required-mode full read-only request/response with exact OID/value comparison
authentication/access negative evidence and trap capture only when explicitly scoped
restore/retention record, secret-redaction audit, BMC health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source's slash-separated v1/v3 Criteria is underspecified, Procedure only inspects UI information and DeepSeek expands the case into agent/trap functionality while offering only an incomplete v3 GET. The review preserves these differences rather than claiming equivalence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The core purpose—validate approved v1/v3 SNMP management behavior—is identifiable. Mode selection, security, OIDs, values and trap inclusion are normal Project Test Plan/readiness inputs, so the hybrid case is confirmation gated rather than permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its PARTIAL/hybrid boundary but requires executable per-mode commands, explicit OIDs and protected credentials and rejects v3-only/trap overclaiming.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION because ED-36 distinguishes a clear protocol test awaiting a project matrix from an irreducible semantic contradiction.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently confirms the non-blocked readiness classification with stronger coverage accounting.

review_improvement: Defines independent v1, v3, query and optional trap evidence while allowing a security-approved project matrix without silently reducing Master coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Unlike the preceding Trap-title case, this row's named objective is general v1/v3 functionality, so a Project Test Plan can legitimately specify the modes, OIDs and values. The attended WebUI step plus automatable protocol transactions fits REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION. Missing inputs delay execution but do not make the purpose unknowable; any reduced v3-only plan must preserve the v1 coverage gap.
